opening: MCP servers; use razor mcp list, add <name> --scope global|project|private --config '<JSON>', remove|enable|disable <name> --scope <scope>, reconnect|sign-in|sign-out <name>, import <file> --scope <scope>, or complete '<redirect address>' in bash to manage them.
availability:
MCP availability changed; these are the configured servers now:
{servers}
availability_empty: No MCP server remains configured; its previously offered tools now refuse.
sign_in: Sign in to {name}: {url}; if the browser then lands on a page that does not load, answer this with that page's address.
url:
The MCP server {name} asks: {message}
Open {url} ({host}) to enter the information there, then accept, decline or cancel.
invalid_form: The answer does not fit this MCP form; answer with a JSON object matching its fields.
elicitation_invalid_url: The MCP server supplied an invalid link; ask it for an HTTP or HTTPS address.
elicitation_unsupported: This MCP question format is unsupported; use a form or a link instead.
